Create a spooky atmosphere with these Halloween Pathway Lights designed to illuminate your home and garden. This set includes eight creepy tree sprig branch stakes each fitted with 20 warm white LED bulbs that cast a spooky glow making them perfect for lining driveways or trick or treat pathways, patios or adding a spooky touch to indoor displays. Standing 74cm tall with stakes attached and rising 60cm above the ground they offer just the right height for visibility. Versatile and customisable these pathway lights feature eight lighting modes giving you the freedom to create the perfect Halloween setting. Built with durability in mind the lights are linked together on a 4.2 metre weatherproof cable suitable for outdoor use even in cold and damp conditions. An additional 5 metre power cable provides flexibility allowing you to position the lights exactly where you want them. The detachable ground stakes ensure secure placement in soil gravel or grass making setup quick and simple. Powered by three AA batteries which are not included the lights are free from mains restrictions giving you more options for placement. They also feature a built in timer function that automatically switches them off after six hours and back on after 18 keeping your display shining bright without the need for daily adjustments. Combining convenience style and reliability these Halloween Pathway Lights are an easy way to enhance your home with spooky magic. Whether creating a spooky glow along your driveway or adding a creepy set up to your garden path, they are a versatile and practical addition to your Halloween set up.

## Features
- Strategically positioned at the tips of pin wires
- Adjusted to produce a mesmerizing starburst effect
- Perfect addition to any festive display
- 8 distinct functions
- Energy-efficient and Eco-friendly

## Information
The LEDs are strategically positioned at the tips of pin wires, which can be finely adjusted to produce a mesmerizing starburst effect. The set boasts starbursts spread over a cable, ensuring a seamless integration into any backdrop. These lights are the perfect addition to any festive display. However, they are not just for Christmas, this set can be used at any point of the year and in a variety of ways, ideal for providing ambient lighting and creating eye-catching scenes. They require 3x AA batteries for operation, which are not included. Users can select from 8 distinct functions static, waves, sequential, chasing, twinkling, steady on, slow glow, and slow fade. These lights are not only energy-efficient and eco-friendly but also feature non-replaceable LEDs. Additionally, there's a built-in timer function that allows for a 6-hour on and 18-hour off cycle. With a 25cm gap between each starburst and a generous cable leading from the battery pack to the initial starburst, placement is versatile. Note that all measurements are approximate and might vary slightly. These lights are versatile, and suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings throughout the year. They promise to be a captivating enhancement for any Christmas display.
